description: Reference results of the baselines on the CLIP benchmark, as reported in the paper: test accuracy (%) averaged over tasks and per task, the validation average of the selected hyperparameters and the selection itself. Reproduce an entry with `if-merge baseline --arch <backbone> --tasks <count> --method <method> [--init <initialization>]`. Post-hoc entries are seed 0; `other_seeds` lists the further ReForge runs (calibration draw and search seed).
